verdict.rationale: There is no explicit AI-training policy or opt-out in the evidence. Two documented mechanisms indirectly keep data out of vendor hands: Temporal Cloud's security docs say it orchestrates encrypted workflows "without ever accessing your sensitive data" (end-to-end encryption), and self-hosted deployment keeps data on the user's own infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or policy that customer data is not used for AI model training, a documented opt-out control, and independent corroboration.
